notes.title: Small Update 10.2.144722
notes.notes:
Hey Pointians!

We've got another patch for you today, bringing an exciting quality-of-life change that's been heavily requested, alongside troublesome bug fixes and a load of optimisations.

As you may have noticed, we've been releasing monthly item packs for free for all players, so make sure to check those out too (:

Release Notes
Build Number: 10.2.144722
New:
 Community request: players can now dismiss the Challenge Reward popup to view their campus after completing a challenge
 Prepatch for future new item releases.
Bug Fixes:
 Fixed an issue where the gamepad cursor can offset when adjusting filters in Student or Staff menu.
 Fixed issue where Plot 6, 10, and 15 are not able to have expulsion ceremonies on sandbox mode.
 Fixed issue where Lecture theatres ignored permissions during summer.
Optimisations:
 Enabled render jobs - moves lots of render work off the main thread.
 Enabled GPU skinning - moves more render work to the GPU.
 Put together, render jobs and GPU skinning save 10-20% of frame time (so roughly a 10-25% boost in FPS).
 Tweaks to many items to more consistently LOD them out when small on-screen.
 Tweaks to many VFX to remove needless use of transparency, which reduces time spent rendering.
 Fix wall shader not batching well with others - results in faster rendering of walls.
 Huge pass over texture sizes and settings - lower memory usage on all platforms, but particularly Switch and PS4, which should make them much more stable.
 Fixes to room templates to prevent hanging when opening the templates menu.

Any issues please let us know by posting over on our bug forums, take care!

notes.title: Summer School Challenge Update 10.0 - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Welcome to summer school!

G‘day mate! Not every Pointion is hiding behind the sofa whilst Krampus skulks around, no! For some, summer is only just getting started, and for the few unsuccessful students, it’s time to catch up or drop out.

Albert Crank has taken a holiday away from his holiday to ask for your expertise in setting up Two Point County's very first Summer School!

Will you take on this brand new Challenge Mode?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/fe536b21a103864406ad9135c6ead1cd7b238e9d.png
Whilst the rest of their academic cohort is taking a well-earned study break, the same can't be said for the unlucky bunch setting off for the county's very first summer school. Doomed (and gloomed) to be held back a year, you'll be working hard to get these students back on track while keeping spirits high. 

Your students have a small case of FOMO, as they watch their Grade A peers sit back and relax, so it’s best to keep them happy and entertained! You’ll have a hard time of it though, as the Ministry of Misery is determined to remind these students that they are, in fact, here as 'punishment' for their lacking grades.

Make sure you’ve enough facilities as students from all walks of academia are registering for Summer School. By making sure to run parties, and, alongside a helping hand from Albert Crank, you have Sunshine Bombs at your disposal, to give your students a lovely Sun-Kissed buff, that way you'll have them getting straight As all whilst they enjoy some forced fun.

New Modding Feature: Walls & Floors!
The latest modding project is out now, accompanied by an ever-useful how-to guide to show you how to make your very own custom walls & floors. Check out the guide here, and join our Discord to chat with other modders!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/1ff1af846f8bea2b7368d842010f8df2c63b0483.png
If you're not looking to tinker with your mods, you can download community-made items, walls and floors on mod.io. Browse in-game, browser or on our community forums.

Challenge Mode Trophies

Must get... all... the shinies!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/f1e83e1590e9710da60bc554430ba37e5e66fef8.png
Is Challenge Mode your jam? Showcase your achievements with the new challenge mode trophies, can you collect them all?

Student Cap Increase

It's been heavily requested by you folks, you can now toggle the student & staff cap in-game to build the biggest MEGA campus ever! Check out the in-game settings for this toggle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/131415d9c36663f109b7a5276421647871ee4a49.png

Winter Theme

Students, this is your annual friendly reminder to NOT feed the reindeer, Cheesy Gubbins. And no, they don't eat homework either!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/29a2b1e73e49d34ede928bb6e681879346a6a8da.png

A frosty spell has hit Two Point County, time to wrap up warm, dust off your festive decor and get ready to deck halls, and lavish faculty and friends alike in festive gifts because the Winter update is here! From today, you can expect a whole host of yuletide treats. Oh and one final thing, please remind students that class is still in session... brain freeze is no excuse!

If you'd prefer your campus with its foliage green, there's an option for you! Head to the settings menu and scroll down to find the Seasonal Content toggle to control the seasons (didn't realise you trained in Dark Arts?!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/5e2e0b580ac2803c0faf07a452f4026831b7e11c.png

Need a recap of everything in our winter update? Check out the full article here, as well as this quick speedrun below:

Evergreen (always in-game):

 Challenge Mode Two Point Krampus!
 Free cheerful customisations and icy items:
 Wintry wallpapers, we got a deal on wrapping paper and thought, multipurpose?
 With the savings on wallpapers, we went all out with new hardwood flooring!
 Bring festive cheer with these items: snow people, a fir wreath, a gift stocking, a Christmas tree, fairy lights, new rugs... and more!

notes.title: Modding Full Release! | Custom Items on Windows, Linux & Mac
notes.notes:
Exciting news everyone!

You might remember a little while ago we launched a beta for modding over on Steam. Well, we’ve been busy working alongside the lovely folks over at mod.io to bring cross-platform modding to Two Point Campus!

Now we’re here with a very exciting update for you all, we’re delighted that ALL PLATFORMS can now use community-created items, meaning you can download custom-modded items and use them in-game!

You may have noticed an extra option appear on the main menu for Two Point Campus, which opens up the mod.io browser where you can see all the modded items available for your platform, and subscribe to items to use them in-game.

Soon we’ll also be introducing floor and wall customisation, meaning you can mod your very own wallpapers and flooring options, to use in Room Customisation. So keep an eye out on socials for this!

Browse our mods here!

[hr]               [/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/154afb29a6744f99e14312e0a853058550f239db.png
How can I download mods?

First, make sure Two Point Campus is updated! Once you load up the game, click the new ‘Mods’ tab on the main menu. In the top right, you’ll see a little meeple, if you press that from there you’ll get a pop-up to guide you through logging in. Follow the steps, it’s a single sign-on process, so once you’ve logged in the first you’re good to go ahead and subscribe to ALL the items you like! 

To use modded items, browse the mods on offer and press the subscribe, if you hit the button before logging in, you’ll be prompted to log into your mod.io account. Your subscribed items will download whilst you’re in the main menu, and a little pop-up will show once installing is done!

Unsubscribing from mods or deleting the mod’s files will cause any in-game items to revert back to a default Two Point Campus item, so your game save won’t be missing any items, this automatic reverting is to prevent any errors from popping up.

[hr]               [/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/c60cdf3e09f546e90f045087f4d0f438e67b6165.png
How can I create my own?

You’ll need a few things before you get started, there’s a handy guide for the initial setup, which includes installing Unity (the game engine we use) alongside setting up the modding project. 

If you get stuck at any point, we’ll do what we can to help out. Modding is all about the community after all! So join our Discord and jump in, no question is silly or not worth asking, plus you can share what you’re working on with the community!

We have a load of guides to help you out on the journey. To get started modding, you can change our ‘Geometric Canvas’ with an image of your choice, like your favourite cat!

You’ll be able to do texture swaps to change things like the image on a poster, or you can fully replace the mesh (skin) of an item with something of your own. If you have a cool idea for a chair, go right ahead and swap your concept with one of our existing ones! We have guides to get you going with this, you can try customising a plant before moving on to choosing your own item meshes to mod.

Please have a read of our best practices for modding, this is particularly handy if you want to share your mods for other players to use!

Modding Guides

[hr]               [/hr]

We’ve been loving what the community has created so far, there are so many awesome items on offer. If you run into any issues using modded items, please unsubscribe from the items so they revert back to their unmodded state. As these are player-made, we do our best to moderate and run checks on them before they go live for you all, but of course, we can’t guarantee everything will always run smoothly so: when in doubt, unsubscribe from mods if you run into issues, and if you’re not sure, as always please do get in touch over on our Bugs forum.

Thanks everyone, we appreciate you supporting our games and we hope you love the new modding tools!

notes.title: Cafeteria Update 9.0 - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Happy hauntings!

What’s Halloween without some tricks AND treats? Alongside a whole cauldron of spooky seasonal goodness, the Cafeteria is now open and ready to serve the BRAND NEW Crumely Student Range. 

Don’t let your cohort stuff themselves on candy before they get the chance to try the culinary delights on offer! There’s something for every grumbling stomach, from the sustainably sourced Recycled Burger to the County’s coolest pasta dish: the Frozen Lasagne. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/e8fa26c5b80ff6f75af0522fdea7c94e27e81714.png
Not happy with Gubbins and microwave meals, you let us know your students needed a Cafeteria! Winning the community favourite feature vote, Crumely has delivered on that promise, with the Cafeteria now open for business! Serving substantial hot meals for your bustling staff and students, if they just make sure the centre has defrosted before tucking in…

The Cafeteria is the best place to get a hot, “home-cooked” meal on campus. Your campus can enjoy brand new eat-a-thon events, leaving your students full of food and stuffed with buffs, and they may even meet the Cheesy Goblin himself (other food-related mascots are available). 

For fast-food efficiency, you can even adjust staff Capacity in the room inspector, to have up to three Assistants working in a single Cafeteria for increased productivity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/475bf581ed245a0d3a84ae46acf68dda4655deeb.gif

Each and every menu item from the Crumely Student Range comes with its very own signature consequence, it’s a fun little surprise for your students to share with all their friends on campus, just like spreading jam on toast!
 Instant Casserole - for when you want a warming meal, but you’ve not got all-day
 Unfoldable Pizza - it’ll fill you up, without filling up your cupboards.
 Recycled Burger - the first person who ate it enjoyed it.
 Frozen Lasagne - the County's coolest pasta.
Your lovely students will enjoy some chit-chat over their hot meals, encouraging relationships to blossom, because who wants to chat with Gubbins dust around their mouth? There’s even a hint of romance in the air, if your students fancy a crummy candle-lit Cafeteria instant casserole, that is…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/2101e6e4041f77370b4dcc20ee08331a645522b0.png

New Things

New Cafeteria Room
 Satiate your students whilst they socialise in the new Cafeteria room:
 Invite the County’s favourite mascots on Campus to new Eat-a-thon events
 Retro-style your cafe with floor and wall customisations
 Seating items available for all clique sizes
 Chaotic-ly large condiment decorations
Seasonal Theming
 Spooky songs so sinister you'll shake and shudder in surprise!
 Frightfully refreshed items for a breath of fresh scare:
 Batty windows
 Don't look under dorm beds...
 All organic ominous orange pumpkin planters
 Even the most diligent janitor can't hold up against the onslaught of cobwebs... Ghastly theming changes:
 Mysterious meta map
 Gastronomy has been spirited away...
 There are 199 steps to climb the Knight's tower, be careful you don't get tangled!
 Who are these apparitions on Spiffinmoore? (are they paying tuition?)
If you'd prefer your campus remain dusted and its foliage green, there's an option for you! Head to the settings menu and scroll down to find the Seasonal Content toggle to control the seasons (didn't realise you trained in Dark Arts?!). The seasonal theming will be live from NOW until 1st November.

We can't wait for you to get stuck in, it wouldn't be the same witch-out you experiencing it for yourselves! Update 9.0 is available now on all platforms.

notes.title: Spring Update 6.0 - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Flowers are budding all across Two Point County, enough to make sure every bunny has an absolutely cracking day! 

Over the next week, it’s time to ring in Spring the right way, make sure to not be late for this very important date as we spring into an ear-resistible bonnet of Spring surprises, whether it’s items ready for blossoming, a couple dozen eggs, or bright new customisations, we’ve got the update that’s sure to ruffle some feathers. Let's hop to it:

[previewyoutube=YO2uCa65PwU;full][/previewyoutube]
Now Spring isn’t all sunny side up, alongside a basket of springtime treats, we need your help cleaning up the egg-related chaos that’s been unleashed all across the County.

New Challenge Mode
You'll be heading down the Rabbit Hole in our latest seasonal challenge: Egg & Silver-Spoon Race! Wiggy Silverbottom, with his trademark combo of excess free time and a surplus of bad ideas, has decided Freshleigh Meadows was in dire need of some ‘egg-citing’ activities this spring…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/fc5f8d1d3af76b25fb50010b241f513feaeef918.png

He's only gone and buried the ENTIRE priceless collection of Fitzpocket Eggs! In the most ultimate of egg hunts, be on the lookout for surface-level finds, whilst your Egg Hunting students head down the Rabbit Hole to uncover peskier eggs hidden deep underground.

To bag the biggest prized egg collection in all the County, you’ll need to buff your fluffy cohort’s academic performance to help along their eggs-cavations. And, outside of the classroom, complete as many objeggtives as possible to reveal clues that lead to even more cracking finds… 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/13a21f69a49534cd0f7d76750b7b70bcc3135446.gif

New Items & Outfit
There’s something in the air! Is it the hum of neighbouring mowers? Or maybe it’s the pollen count? (… help). No matter the annoyances, mother nature has bought a blossoming bounty in our latest seasonal selection!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/7fc2a935ec0bfef5b9247e3673dfa68865b5272f.png

The whole County is ready to celebrate all things bright and beautiful, so give your students and staff a good hare-day with the new Bunny Ears outfit, and give your campus a Spring clean with new in-game items.  There’s something for every bunny! (…although if we catch you about to take a bite of the lovely Chocolate Rabbit we will NEVER forgive you).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/4931e34bf4340b84d144ac42f2e9fa9c917f6674.gif

New Things
 New Challenge Mode Level: Egg & Silver-Spoon Race

 Three new wallpapers
 Spring Chickens
 Chocolate Rabbit

 …a super secret surprise item for completion of the Community Challenge!

notes.title: Valentine's Update 4.0 - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Happy Valentine's everyone!

Whilst an A+ would be nice, they do say all you need is love! It's a good job then that something is in the air in Two Point County, you won't be needing your rose-tinted glasses for this one! So try not to swoon as we check out everything Cupid's quiver has to offer:

[previewyoutube=BklokIZXGMQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope pink is your favourite colour as we're smitten by the hamper of heart-shaped decor, including the cutest of new costumes, an infatuation of red balloons, and SO many roses, there are so many... too many...

New Challenge Mode​
Cupid is VERY busy this Valentine's, scouting out the best romantic locations across the County, looking to spread love and happiness to all (what a sweetheart), and if he’s suitably impressed with your Campus he’ll even leave you a few of his Love Bombs for you to create your very own romances. Get your students all loved up to score points and win hearts in our latest challenge mode!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/d34d895feb428729aad481e95785e64c125d1491.gif

Cupid's bow-and-arrow approach really wasn't cut out for spreading love in the modern age. Instead, he's come up with some new-fangled contraptions, but, there's only a limited number to spread as much love as possible! Only through impressing Cupid by creating the most promising romantic locations can you earn some of his coveted supply.

Cupid is travelling the County to find the best of the best! Only once you've enamoured Cupid with absolute pink pandemonium on your campus, alongside all-round student happiness, AND ensuring you don't fall out of love with your grades, will you be guaranteed to catch his eye! Now impressed, he'll reward your romantic potential.

Love Bombs will fall from the sky, ready for action, to create the perfect romantic atmosphere. Once you're gifted one from Cupid himself, you'll choose where to let it off, releasing a mist of romantic ambience. Now lovestruck, students are drawn to cultivate romances (isn't that much easier than the old bow-and-arrow?).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/0c5b036ef93ddd4b25bbd9e9ec7e078176dc475a.gif

New Items & Outfit
Celebrate all things lovely with the love-filled new items in-game. Whether you're partial to a vase full of roses, or bringing out every Goth student's worse enemy: PINK! If you can think of it, there's a heart-shaped version of it ready to bring joy (or vertigo) to all your lovely students. 

Show your romantic flare by rolling out the new heart-shaped rug, bunting, and pink balloons, or bring a loving touch to some existing items, like using the new wallpapers or duvet set. And if that's not enough, then why not go all out with a Tunnel of Love? Nothing says romance quite like a giant mechanical swan.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/6f54cdefc214fd59f70b302d5f63c4dfc7bc243c.png

The whole county is under Cupid's love spell, so expect heartwarming in-game changes, with heart-print duvets, wallpaper, and pink ambience absolutely everywhere! As the busy Cupid can't be everywhere at once, your staff and students alike can experience a touch of the divine by stepping into Cupid's (striking) oh-so-romantic character outfit.

New Things
 New Challenge: The L-Bomb
 New Outfit: Cupid
 New, temporary Valentine's Day theme on the Main Menu
 Free Valentine's items:
 Tunnel of Love
 Love Balloons
 Heart Rug
 Concentric Hearts
 Stacked Hearts
 Rose Bouquet 
 Rose Vase
Bug Fixes:
 Added a number of stability improvements to optimise memory usage
 Fixed an issue where janitors were not efficiently cleaning up the campus
 Fixed an issue where selecting the Items List from the Room Inspector would close the Room Inspector UI
 Dorm templates or copies no longer get flagged for invalid items when rotated
 Wall items from rooms that have been picked up will no longer remain in their original place
 Fixed an area on Pebberley Ruins where items can be placed but are not reachable
 Fixed NPCs getting stuck on the Rocket Pad area in the first Space Academy level
 Status icons in the student list now give correct information on what the student is doing
 Fixed a problem with Moles spawning, players should have no trouble getting them to spawn now
 Minor fix for the newsfeed on Main Menu not displaying some events
 "Strange Meteors" advisor now shows the correct character
 Fixed a bug where earthquakes in certain levels were causing the game to crash.
As always, if you'd prefer your campus NOT to be pretty in pink, there's an option for you! Head to the settings menu and scroll down to find the Seasonal Content toggle to control the seasons (didn't realise you trained in Dark Arts?!).

Parting is such sweet sorrow... No need to be mournful for long, as once Valentine's is over, all newly added items (including the new costume and challenge mode) will remain in the game! So you'll be able to enjoy the content in your own time, all we'll do is collect up all the balloons and pink theming from the meta-map and main menu.

We can't wait for you to experience the lovely aura across campus, it's truly captivating! Update 4.0 is available now!

notes.title: Winter Update 3.0 - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Warmest of wishes, Pointians!

Students, this is your annual friendly reminder to NOT feed the reindeer Cheesy Gubbins. And no, they don't eat homework either!

A frosty spell has hit Two Point County, time to wrap up warm, dust off your festive decor and get ready to deck halls, and lavish faculty and friends alike in festive gifts because the Winter update is here! From today, you can expect a whole host of yuletide treats. Oh and one final thing, please remind students that class is still in session... brain freeze is no excuse! 

We can't think of anything as nice as wintertime, even that frosty bite in the air... but alongside all the festivity, we need some help spreading seasonal cheer in our latest Challenge Mode, as a new adversary arrives, and they're up to snow good! With a sleigh full of wonder, let's see what the elves have in store!

[previewyoutube=iEjE_BEmOn8;full][/previewyoutube]

Challenge Mode
The student body needs your help in taking on one of County's grinchiest residents, the Two Point Krampus! We need you to lighten everyone's holiday spirits ASAP, or else we fear they'll bring gloom to all of Campus!

The Two Point Krampus is a grumpy one, whilst everyone in the County is enjoying Winter a whole lot, the Krampus HATES the whole festive season! Now, we aren't quite sure of the reason, but the Krampus has come onto Campus to spread their festive uncheer! We do know one thing for sure and it's that a well-placed gift can bring joy to even the biggest of humbugs! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/b5ae961f67a1fa29b754121275d1f4c75192c0ea.png

In order to make everything merry and bright in our Winter Challenge Mode, we'll need to make sure we have enough money in the bank to get the Krampus a gift big enough to bribe him into being on the nice list, so you'll need to raise money across 2 years by protecting the festive spirit (student happiness) from this demonic (and hairy) buzzkill. Not only that, but whilst dodging the Two Point Krampus, you better watch out or your students might get caught up in some particularly frosty weather...

New Items & Outfits
Every student loves a snow day, and some have decided to take it literally this year... celebrate all things wintry with the new festive outfits, whether it's weathering your faculty with snowball heads, or choosing something merry like Santa suits or elf outfits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/58bf3f0204f8e56263849115af12b983c0d135c1.png

Make sure your Campuses are bright and jolly, a cosy feel can really make a difference. Gift-wrapped decorations are now available, if you're partial to some merry decor then rejoice with festive wreaths and fir trees, or for those who are anti-big light, bring some sparkle to your campus and deck the whole place in fairy lights!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/6f44fa7bd02eea25c6a58cdf745f4c55405ddd7c.png

New Things:
 A new challenge level: Two Point Krampus!
 Free cheerful customisations and icy items:
 Wintry wallpapers, we got a deal on wrapping paper and thought, multipurpose?
 With the savings on wallpapers, we went all out with new hardwood flooring!
 Bring festive cheer with new free items: snow people, a fir wreath, gift stocking, Christmas tree, fairy lights, new rugs... and more!
 Ice cold theming changes:
 You'll be needing mittens to attend Mitton
 A yellow snow warning has been issued at Piazza!
 No pipers are piping, but merry music will have you a-leaping through the festive season
 Glacial globes spotted on the meta map
 Icy item swaps
 Bundle up tight in four new outfits
 ...and a whole partridge in a pear tree more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/281b981ad2771f2b4e6e02918f4cf3c66a9b3bd1.png

For anyone who's worried about missing out, don't worry! These snow people don't melt away, all items, costumes, and the challenge mode will remain after the event period. All your festive items even work in Two Point Campus’ Space Academy DLC, which is out now on all platforms.

If you'd prefer your campus with its foliage green, there's an option for you! Head to the settings menu and scroll down to find the Seasonal Content toggle to control the seasons (didn't realise you trained in Dark Arts?!).

We can't have festivity without the whole County family revelling in the wintry wonder, jump into update 3.0, now available on PC, Nintendo Switch, Xbox and PlayStation.

notes.title: Halloween Update 2.0 - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Happy hauntings!

Strange things are afoot in Two Point County... make sure to check under dormitory beds, as students start acting like complete pumpkin heads; because the spooky season is here! Over the next week, you can expect a whole cornucopia of eerie goings-on, whether it's music designed to send a shiver down your spine, or a whole heap of pumpkins, we've got the update for you to really bring a gourd-geous look to your campus!

Now, what's Halloween without both tricks and treats? Alongside a whole cauldron of refreshed in-game items, we need your help with some troublesome tricks as you delve into our new Challenge Mode. So, let's get startled!

[previewyoutube=-tPFbS6VpZI;full][/previewyoutube]

Challenge Mode

Delve into our new devilish challenges to cement your high score on the leaderboard. There are two challenges to get your fangs stuck into:

 The Siege of Noblestead - a groaning mob is amassing on campus (and no, it's not the morning after a party!). Lord Blaggard is in no mood for an undead horde, can you keep them at bay?
 Pumpkin High - orange you glad you enrolled? Nefaria Munch has transfigured your students into her Pumpkin Headed minions, and they really need help carving out study time...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/2f5dcb01054ccba4936236f6d27ab5916461ff02.gif

Student Customisation & New Items

We have three spooktakular new outfits available for staff and students, where wolf we be without the odd distraction in the academic calendar?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/1f6de505134fce41f3f480880923c1cc68966e9d.gif

Make sure your classrooms aren't feeling left out from the fancy dress party, deck them out with our new eerie items, designed to set the perfect haunting mood. The whole County is getting into the spirit, so keep an eye out for all the in-game changes with this Halloween refresh (or rather de-fresh, where did all these cobwebs come from?!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/52ddc22e043a41d6b6ce14222305bfae35d31b2f.jpg

New Things

 New challenge game mode & customisation feature
 Spooky songs so sinister you'll shake and shudder in surprise!
 Frightfully refreshed items for a breath of fresh scare:

 Batty windows
 Don't look under dorm beds...
 All organic ominous orange pumpkin planters
 Even the most diligent janitor can't hold up against the onslaught of cobwebs...
 Free creepy creative items: pumpkins, a spooky tree, terrifying table, wallpaper, bunting and even more pumpkins!
 Ghastly theming changes:

 Mysterious metamap
 Gastronomy has been spirited away...
 There are 199 steps to climb the Knights tower, be careful you don't get tangled!
 Who're these apparitions on Spiffinmoore? (are they paying tuition?)
 ..and much more spookiness for you to find!

If you'd prefer your campus remain dusted and its foliage green, there's an option for you! Head to the settings menu and scroll to find the Seasonal Content toggle to control the seasons (didn't realise you trained in Dark Arts?!).

We can't wait for you to get stuck in, it wouldn't be the same witch-out you all experiencing it for yourselves! Update 2.0 is available now. Check out the full release notes below:

notes.title: Update 1.5 - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

A brand new update is coming to Two Point Campus with lots of bug fixes, changes, and some FREE items! This is an exciting one for us as it's our first update with some cool new stuff that we hope you'll all really like (as well as bug fixes of course - we all like those!)

We're sure you're eager to hear all about what's coming in update 1.5, so let's dive right in.

New Items
While the code team have been busy fixing bugs, our art team have been busy making some lovely new items for you to enjoy! 

First up... TINY RADIATORS AND SUCH. We heard you were missing the small radiators and air-con units from Two Point Hospital, so we added some similar items for Campus. These are really useful for those of you wanting to min/max your rooms efficiently.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/1cce00e3899a1aa01c4136562cadba8f9205d627.jpg

Next up... a new relationship AND entertainment item! There's nothing quite like going on a see-saw ride with the person you love the most, right?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/337e1539504dda499cf52678835d4110729a5dad.jpg

For those preferring to entertain themselves, how about a personal mini-golf course. It's like a "personal pizza" but you can't eat it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/5a58d83839ab02a93d89475bf2e4d9874d28e3e8.jpg

New Creative Items
Hedges and Fences were already a great way to pretty-up your campus, but now with these new additions your building skills are going to go from here... to HERE (yes... you're right, that phrase doesn't work when you don't have hand gestures to go with them... but you get the idea).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/f2effceae3b81f842e0ee39ca94dafa2ec10a1fc.jpg

How about some new paths? Ohhhh yeaaahhh! We've added two new pathing tools to our smartbrushes AND we've made some improvements in general to make the existing ones look even better!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/b9ee1355f5c6a220f63a6f80c96ef44ab2841e35.jpg

Job Assignment Menu
Possibly the most requested feature so far has been the Job Assignment screen, where you can select which areas of work each member of staff can focus on. So we're very excited to announce its arrival in Update 1.5! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/56d5e67b06cda211201ad18ab5c3aad15a2047e9.jpg

That's not everything either! We've got a whole host of bug fixes for you too, so be sure to check out the release notes below for all the info:

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4.110651 (12.09.2022)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We've got a new hotfix ready for you to download now, with fixes for some of the most common issues we've had reported. Take a look below at the release notes for more info:

Release Notes:

Build: 1.4.110651
Fix for sandbox metagame saves getting kudosh and unlocks wiped sometimes
Fix for players who missed getting the radiator in Mitton
Stability improvements

We've got more updates in the works for the future too, so keep an eye out for more info a little later down the line!

notes.title: Version 1.4.110037 Hotfix (31st August)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We hope you've been having fun building up your universities so far! 

We've got a little hotfix for you today which should help with some of the crashes you've been reporting, as well a couple of other smaller fixes too. Check out the release notes below for more info.

Release Notes:
Build #1.4.110037
Fix for a Unity bug, which was causing crashing. For players that experienced this bug, the level would be crashing at around the same point each load
Fix for templates not overwriting correctly
Fix for small bug with the training room item

This hotfix is available to download now!

We've got more fixes coming soon, so please continue to report any bugs you see on the forum!

notes.title: Patch 1.4 - Bug Fixes & Improvements - Available Now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been amazing seeing so many of you enjoying Two Point Campus, we're so pleased you like it! 

Since launch, our team have been hard at work reading through bug reports and getting the pesky things fixed. We've already released a couple of smaller hotfixes, but todays update has a whole slew of brand new fixes for some of the most reported bugs we've seen, and brings us up to release 1.4. 

Release notes:

General
General Optimisation of behavior system
Sandbox Mode now unlocks after achieving 1 star in Freshleigh
Course management is now disabled in the first year of the tutorial
Improvements to Sandbox create new save UI
Training room improvements: Janitors no longer count towards room capacity
Teachers can now train while janitors are repairing the pod.
Room Capacity warning is now at 100%, rather than 90%
Improvements to subtitles
Improved some of the Chinese translations

Bug Fixes
Item placement improvements and bug fixing
General Stability Improvements
Update the icon for when there is a queue for a room, and the icon for when the room is at capacity to be more intuitive.
Updated messaging when you have an item on the cursor that should be placed outside if trying to place it inside
Internet History bookcase is now awarded during the Career. If you are past the point where it gets awarded, you should now have it available in the Library items list.
You can now rename stuff, students and rooms with a controller
Fixed a bug where it wasn't possible to scroll down correctly in the items info tab
Fixed a bug where it wasn't possible to change the name of a custom Sandbox (we have found another bug with this that we will be fixing!)
Fixed missing item rotation keybind
Gig visitors no longer count towards room capacity
Fix for "arrival points blocked" error on Nobelstead
Add toggle in settings to disable controller input on PC (we are still investigating the cause of the issues around controllers on PC)
Fixed a bug where photomode short key (6) was not triggering photomode
On using controller when browsing the staff list the north button now pick's up staff
Improved messaging when you have an item on the cursor that should be placed outside
Fixed Typo in finance screens in English
Fix for being unable to launch game if your current system date format culture is one not supported by the current log file string format
Fixed a bug where pressing back without accepting the safe area setting still applies the changed setting in-game.
Fixed a bug where the room build menu's subtract button was disabled but you could still go into bulldoze mode.
Fixed a bug where the button prompts in the timetable menu were not disappearing after the lesson/event inspector was opened.
Fixed an issue with the framerate limiter
Fix exploit where you could copy Artifact items in Sandbox
Fixed a bug when on returning to Mitton from later in the game, you didn't get applicants with all types of qualifications
Fixed Delete and Cancel operation when moving existing procedural items
Fixed keyboard shortcuts being fired when editing text.
Fix high FPS breaking Pan Camera tutorial objective
Fixed copied scenario rooms not deducting base tile cost.
Fixed weird behavior with play/fast forward buttons
Fixed changing teacher job assignment not updating next years timetable
Single fence / hedge posts are now selectable.
Fix for crash when signing in to Two Point County in Traditional Chinese
Fix for being unable to place items in Nobelstead occasionally
Potential fix for some players who are having issues with saving their game
Fix for rotate item tutorial showing WW instead of Z and X
Fix for crash on Mac if VSYNC is turned on. If you experienced this crash please see pinned post in bug forum
Fix for students sometimes not going on to to duelling stage in the Spell Room
Fixed issue with the Podium in Student Union that was making it hard to place down
Fix for Mole not being spawned in Bludergrad

We have more on the way, so please continue to report any issues you find in the Bugs section of the Steam forum!

notes.title: Version 1.3 Hotfix (12th August)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We hope that you're enjoying the game!

We have a hotfix for a few of issues that have been reported:


 A Key not working on some keyboard layouts
 Crash for users in some specific timezones
 Fix for issue with keybinds freezing
 Fix for some issues with saves loading


Please note - The tutorial prompt UI doesn't update to show the correct keys, but functionality will be working. We will fix this in another patch.

We are investigating and fixing other bugs, and will release other updates as soon as we can. Please continue to let us know if you are having any issues, and we will look in to them as soon as as can.

Build number: 1.3.108799

notes.title: Two Point Campus Release Date News
notes.notes:
Hi lovelies!

We have some news to share that we know will no doubt disappoint some of you. As always, we'll cut right to the chase - We've made the difficult decision to push the launch of Two Point Campus back from 17th May 2022 to 9th August 2022. 

BUT... it's for the best, we promise! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704896/38d116534a40046b40dc8477fb4feffa74a5d96f.gif

As you know, one of our biggest goals with Two Point Campus is to launch on PC and console platforms from day one, and we want to make sure that every single one of you gets the best quality game no matter what you're playing on. So in order for everyone to have the incredible experience we all want you to have, we need a little more time to continue our optimisation efforts for all platforms. Now don't get us wrong... we're nearly there! So the extra three months we have is going to really help us get Two Point Campus to the quality you've all come to expect from us as a studio. 

Mark Webley, Studio Director at Two Point Studios had this to say:

"Our ambition from the start has been to release Two Point Campus across all PC and console platforms simultaneously to the quality and standard that our community expects from us. This means we will need a little bit more time with Two Point Campus to make sure we deliver the best possible game that can be enjoyed equally on all platforms”. We will use these additional three months to optimise Two Point Campus for all platforms.”

Of course, we understand some people might be feeling disappointed with this news. Honestly, we are too. We're really excited for you to get started in the game, but it just wouldn't be fair on you or ourselves to release a game that isn't quite ready yet. We're committed to making sure everyone gets the best possible experience while playing Two Point Campus! 

Even though the release date has been pushed back a little, we've still got A LOT to show you! So why not take a moment to grab some Cheesy Gubbins, and let Mark Webley, Gary Carr and more of our lovely dev team show you what's waiting for you on August 9th in our brand new Developer Vision video!
